decisions.reason: Product A went from its own page to a simple mention, which suggests results fell short of the aspiration, but upholstery fabrics usually stay in the collection for several seasons, so dropping it now is premature.

Product B has had steady but low-key visibility for two years, which fits a stable collection item that slack can carry, though its modest profile leaves some risk of being cut when the range is renewed.
Product C has kept its own page in both years and serves the contract market, where flame-retardant certification is required, which signals performance at or above aspiration.
Product D has been mentioned consistently in both years without any promotion, so it is a stable but unremarkable item that is likely to stay unless the collection is reshuffled.
Product E's niche wool bouclé leno appears to be carried along with modest visibility, so problemistic search could target it, but there is no clear signal of a shortfall yet.
Product F is the newest launch and has prominent placement on its own page, and management will give it time to meet aspirations before judging it.
